shadows.name: drawer
shadows.purpose: Installed Element Plus dark shadow used by drawers.

motion.name: navigation
motion.purpose: Navigation background changes. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary button
components.css: .ds-primary{box-sizing:border-box;height:32px;padding:8px 15px;border:1px solid var(--el-border-color,#dcdfe6);border-radius:var(--el-border-radius-base,4px);font:500 14px "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "微软雅黑", Arial, sans-serif;line-height:1;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;cursor:pointer;transition:all .1s;background:var(--el-color-primary,#7045a5);border-color:var(--el-color-primary,#7045a5);color:#fff}.ds-primary:hover{background:var(--el-color-primary-light-3,#9b7dc0);border-color:var(--el-color-primary-light-3,#9b7dc0)}.ds-primary:active{background:var(--el-color-primary-dark-2,#5a3784);border-color:var(--el-color-primary-dark-2,#5a3784)}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--el-color-primary-light-5,#b8a2d2);outline-offset:1px;}

components.name: Default button
components.css: .ds-default{box-sizing:border-box;height:32px;padding:8px 15px;border:1px solid var(--el-border-color,#dcdfe6);border-radius:var(--el-border-radius-base,4px);font:500 14px "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "微软雅黑", Arial, sans-serif;line-height:1;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;cursor:pointer;transition:all .1s;background:#fff;color:var(--el-text-color-regular,#606266)}.ds-default:hover{background:var(--el-color-primary-light-9,#f1ecf6);border-color:var(--el-color-primary-light-7,#d4c7e4);color:var(--el-color-primary,#7045a5)}.ds-default:active{border-color:var(--el-color-primary,#7045a5)}.ds-default:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--el-color-primary-light-5,#b8a2d2);outline-offset:1px;}

components.name: Search input
components.description: Labeled search using the default input dimensions.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">搜索设备<input class="ds-search" placeholder="搜索设备、账户或备注"></label>
components.css: .ds-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;font:14px "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "微软雅黑", Arial, sans-serif;color:var(--el-text-color-regular,#606266)}.ds-search{box-sizing:border-box;height:32px;padding:1px 11px;border:0;border-radius:var(--el-border-radius-base,4px);background:#fff;color:var(--el-text-color-regular,#606266);font:14px "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "微软雅黑", Arial, sans-serif;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--el-border-color,#dcdfe6) inset}.ds-search:hover{box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--el-border-color-hover,#c0c4cc) inset}.ds-search:focus-visible{outline:none;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--el-color-primary,#7045a5) inset}

components.name: Selected navigation
components.description: Persistent navigation shows text when expanded and accessible icon links with hover and focus tooltips when collapsed.
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-height:44px;padding:0 12px;border-radius:var(--el-border-radius-base,4px);font:500 14px "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "微软雅黑", Arial, sans-serif;text-decoration:none;background:var(--el-color-primary-light-9,#f1ecf6);color:var(--el-color-primary,#7045a5);transition:background-color 160ms ease-out}.ds-nav:hover{background:var(--el-color-primary-light-9,#f1ecf6)}.ds-nav:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--el-color-primary,#7045a5);outline-offset:3px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav{transition:none}}

components.name: Information tag
components.description: Read-only labeled state using the Element Plus info variant.
components.css: .ds-tag{box-sizing:border-box;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;height:24px;padding:0 9px;border:1px solid var(--el-color-info-light-8,#e9e9eb);border-radius:var(--el-border-radius-base,4px);background:var(--el-color-info-light-9,#f4f4f5);color:var(--el-color-info,#909399);font:12px "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "微软雅黑", Arial, sans-serif;line-height:1}

components.name: Bordered data table
components.description: Static preview of bordered rows and masked material identity. Production tables use ElTable.
components.css: .ds-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;background:#fff;color:var(--el-text-color-regular,#606266);font:14px "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "微软雅黑", Arial, sans-serif}.ds-table th,.ds-table td{border:1px solid var(--el-border-color-lighter,#ebeef5);padding:8px 12px;text-align:left;line-height:23px}.ds-table th{font-weight:600;color:var(--el-text-color-secondary,#909399)}.ds-table tbody tr:hover{background:var(--el-fill-color-light,#f6f5f8)}

narrative.overview:
The approved Airtable-inspired direction organizes Chinese business labels around visible navigation, table views, and focused drawers. The reference defines layout and flow. Element Plus supplies the controls and their geometry.

Color identifies primary actions and selected navigation. Tables retain visible borders, while secondary information uses disclosures and drawers. Task scope, command uncertainty, and resource cleanup remain visible where they affect an operation.
keyCharacteristics: Text and icon navigation with persistent connection status.
Bordered Element Plus tables with views and labeled operations.
Purple color theming with default control geometry.
Drawers for task selection, business editing, and import.

rules.name: The Color-Only Rule
rules.body: Theme Element Plus internals through color variables. Preserve default control dimensions, radii, padding, and interaction styling.

rules.name: Sidebar layout
rules.body: CSS owns shell grid tracks. Expanded navigation is 190px, or 150px up to 760px. The explicit Element Plus toggle persists a 68px collapsed rail when storage is available, with centered icons and connection dot. Collapsed tooltips support hover and focus without consuming Enter.

dos: Do retain Element Plus default geometry and use color variables for control theming.
Do use bordered ElTable for every data table.
Do retain Chinese accessible navigation labels, keyboard focus, and labeled state feedback in both sidebar states.
Do retain draft guards, full editing fields, and resource or command recovery controls.
donts: Don't replace operational controls with prototype-specific custom controls.
Don't expose full card numbers or CVV in table content, tooltips, or accessible labels.
Don't describe recent snapshots as a complete task archive.
Don't add decorative card shadows or collapse navigation without the explicit sidebar toggle.
